E-Q2_addendum.reason: R3 makes sigma enter dynamics ONLY through the SIGN of pressure = real_acc + resonance*sigma. On E-Q1's task class the pair members' real_acc is identically 0 (weather >= 10 toroidal away, Ground does not forward), so sign(sigma*resonance) is positive for EVERY swept sigma > 0 and the plain class cannot discriminate sigma — pre-registered as a possible full-tie outcome. To give C3's sweep a real decision, a second task class is added, same discipline, BEFORE any E-Q2 run:
E-Q2_addendum.class_2_shadowed_twins: same 20 seeds / same pair coordinates as E-Q1; ADDITIONALLY each pair member gets exactly 2 adjacent Repel(d=33) cells (offsets (1,0) and (0,1) from the member, collision-checked loudly at planting) -> member real_acc = -66 every tick; twin term = resonance*sigma = 67*sigma.
E-Q2_addendum.sigma_flip_threshold: pressure sign flips to positive iff 67*sigma > 66, i.e. sigma > 66/67 ~= 0.98507. The swept set {0.5, 1, log2(3)~1.585, 2, 4} STRADDLES the threshold: pre-registered mechanistic prediction: sigma=0.5 DESCENDS (members erode toward d=0, bridge ladder collapses downward), sigma in {1, log2(3), 2, 4} ASCEND (members climb toward saturation d=63). If the data splits anywhere other than between 0.5 and 1, this prediction is falsified and the autopsy follows the real coupling.
E-Q2_addendum.amended_verdict_rule_sealed: per class: (i) report bridge rate, median ticks-to-first-bridge, IQR, delivery ticks at theta=8, final member d (min/mean/max), per-arm byte-plane hashes; (ii) for the plain class the sealed rule stands (argmax bridge rate -> argmin median first-bridge tick -> argmin IQR -> full tie = 'sigma monotone-inert on this class, honest null for C3 HERE'); (iii) for the shadowed class the CRITICAL BAND is [highest failing sigma, lowest passing sigma) where passing = member d strictly increases from its planted value by T; log2(3) is named 'special' ONLY if it is the unique swept value at a band edge; otherwise the verdict states the band and states that the gift's number is not singled out by the data.
E-Q2_addendum.metrics_note: imaginary-mass divergence across sigma arms: sum over ticks of |M_sigma(t) - M_1(t)| with M = total per-tick sum of event terms; recorded as receipted strings (floats never hashed).
